decision.name: ARCHIVE_LOCK_ACQUIRE_FAILURE_LEAK
decision.finding: ArchiveWriterLock.__enter__ creates observations.jsonl.lock via os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL), then writes the PID with os.write. If os.write raises (e.g. I/O error) after successful file creation, the except block closes fd and re-raises but never unlinks the just-created lock. This leaves an orphan lock even without a process crash; future readers/writers time out. This is directly visible in pinned storage.py source, not an executed reproduction or production incident.
test_contract: On isolated exact-SHA checkout add TEST-ONLY deterministic case in part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_concurrent_dedup.py using tmp_path; seed one valid observation and assert no pre-existing .jsonl.lock.

With monkeypatch.context, replace storage.os.write only during ArchiveWriterLock.__enter__ to raise OSError(ENOSPC, 'simulated lock PID write failure'); call with ArchiveWriterLock(archive,timeout=0.05,poll_interval=0.005) inside pytest.raises(OSError). Restore os.write before any subsequent assertions.

Assert no leaked .jsonl.lock after failed __enter__; current pinned code predicts FAIL. Record exact exception, path, and file existence. Separately prove a new ArchiveWriterLock(archive,timeout=0.05,poll_interval=0.005) can be acquired after the failed attempt; current code predicts TimeoutError.

In finally, only for this isolated tmp_path fixture and after confirming no live owner, remove the deliberately orphaned test lock so the suite cannot contaminate other tests. Never introduce automatic stale lock deletion in production.

Run targeted python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_concurrent_dedup.py then python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests; capture exit codes and exact SHA. No network. Do not treat test contract as executed.
decision.integration_priority: Narrow acquisition-failure cleanup proof is a more defensible A integration gate than unconditional three-output atomicity; the latter remains characterization until a real consumer contract requires it. Existing crash-orphan fail-closed behavior must remain protected; any production repair is Gemini-only after reliable JSON and queue gates.
